description: This file contains test helper functions and mock setups for testing WhatsApp-related modules, including configuration mocks, session management, and external dependencies mocking using Vitest.

methods.name: setLoadConfigMock
methods.description: Sets a mock function for loading configuration, replacing the global config mock.

methods.name: resetLoadConfigMock
methods.description: Resets the load config mock to default configuration.

methods.name: resetBaileysMocks
methods.description: Resets and recreates mocks for the Baileys WhatsApp session, including socket and version fetch functions.

methods.name: getLastSocket
methods.description: Retrieves the last mocked Baileys socket instance.
